name: photoshop_play_action
description: Play a recorded action from the Actions palette

name: photoshop_execute_script
description: Execute custom ExtendScript (JSX) code inside Photoshop (advanced escape hatch).\n\n

name: photoshop_adjust_brightness_contrast
description: Adjust brightness and contrast of the active layer.\n\n

name: photoshop_adjust_hue_saturation
description: Adjust hue, saturation, and lightness of the active layer

name: photoshop_auto_levels
description: Apply auto levels adjustment to the active layer.\n\n

name: photoshop_auto_contrast
description: Apply auto contrast adjustment to the active layer

name: photoshop_adjust_curves
description: Create a Curves adjustment layer on the active document.\n\n

name: photoshop_desaturate
description: Desaturate the active layer (convert to grayscale)

name: photoshop_invert
description: Invert colors of the active layer

name: photoshop_apply_lut
description: Apply a Color Lookup (3D LUT) adjustment layer for cinematic color grading. Accepts a built-in LUT name (e.g. "Crisp_Warm.3dl", "Kodak 5218 Fuji 3510.3dl", "Moonlight.3dl") or an absolute path to a .cube/.3dl/.look file.\n\n

name: photoshop_adjust_vibrance
description: Create a Vibrance adjustment layer. Vibrance boosts muted colors while protecting skin tones.\n\n

name: photoshop_adjust_exposure
description: Create an Exposure adjustment layer (stops, offset, gamma correction).\n\n

name: photoshop_apply_photo_filter
description: Create a Photo Filter adjustment layer (warming/cooling/custom tint with density control).\n\n

name: photoshop_apply_gradient_map
description: Create a Gradient Map adjustment layer (black→white by default) for duotone/B&W tonal remapping.\n\n

name: photoshop_list_datasets
description: List the data sets defined on the active document (Image > Variables > Data Sets).\n\n

name: photoshop_import_datasets
description: Import a Photoshop variables/data-sets XML file into the active document (the same file Image > Variables > Data Sets > Import accepts).\n\n

name: photoshop_generate_from_datasets
description: Batch-export the active document once per data set: applies each data set, saves a copy, moves on. "Mail merge for images".\n\n

name: photoshop_create_document
description: Create a new empty Photoshop document with specified dimensions and color mode.\n\n

name: photoshop_get_document_info
description: Get information about the active Photoshop document

name: photoshop_list_documents
description: List every open Photoshop document with id, dimensions, and which tab is active (read-only).\n\n

name: photoshop_set_active_document
description: Switch the active document tab by document_id (preferred), zero-based index, or name.\n\n

name: photoshop_save_document
description: Save the active document to disk in PSD, JPEG, or PNG format.\n\n

name: photoshop_close_document
description: Close the active Photoshop document

name: photoshop_export_as
description: Export a copy of the active document as PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF without changing the open document. WebP/AVIF require Photoshop 23.2+/recent builds and return a clear error when unsupported.\n\n

name: photoshop_apply_gaussian_blur
description: Apply Gaussian Blur filter to the active layer

name: photoshop_apply_sharpen
description: Apply Unsharp Mask (sharpen) filter to the active layer

name: photoshop_apply_noise
description: Apply Add Noise filter to the active layer

name: photoshop_apply_motion_blur
description: Apply Motion Blur filter to the active layer

name: photoshop_apply_high_pass
description: Apply the High Pass filter to the active raster layer — edge/detail extraction for sharpening workflows or frequency separation prep.\n\n

name: photoshop_apply_smart_blur
description: Apply the Smart Blur filter to the active raster layer — edge-preserving blur for smoothing skin or simplifying backgrounds.\n\n

name: photoshop_generative_upscale
description: Upscale the active document using Generative Upscale (PS 27+).\n\n

name: photoshop_sky_replacement
description: Replace the sky using Photoshop native Sky Replacement when available.\n\n

name: photoshop_generate_image
description: Generate image content from a text prompt (text-to-image) on blank or active document.\n\n

name: photoshop_undo
description: Undo the last operation(s) - equivalent to Ctrl/Cmd+Z

name: photoshop_redo
description: Redo the previously undone operation(s) - equivalent to Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z

name: photoshop_get_history
description: Get the history states of the active document

name: photoshop_place_image
description: Place an external image file as a new layer in the active document.\n\n

name: photoshop_open_image
description: Open an image file as a new Photoshop document.\n\n

name: photoshop_resize_image
description: Resize the active image to specified dimensions

name: photoshop_crop_document
description: Crop the document to specified bounds

name: photoshop_move_layer_to_position
description: Move the active layer relative to another layer

name: photoshop_move_layer_to_top
description: Move the active layer to the top of the layer stack

name: photoshop_move_layer_to_bottom
description: Move the active layer to the bottom of the layer stack

name: photoshop_move_layer_up
description: Move the active layer up one position in the layer stack

name: photoshop_move_layer_down
description: Move the active layer down one position in the layer stack

name: photoshop_rasterize_layer
description: Rasterize the active layer (convert text/smart object to normal layer)

name: photoshop_set_layer_opacity
description: Set the opacity of the active layer

name: photoshop_set_layer_blend_mode
description: Set the blend mode of the active layer.\n\n

name: photoshop_set_layer_visibility
description: Show or hide the active Photoshop layer

name: photoshop_set_layer_locked
description: Lock or unlock the active layer

name: photoshop_rename_layer
description: Rename the active layer in the open Photoshop document

name: photoshop_duplicate_layer
description: Duplicate the active layer. The duplicate becomes the active layer;

name: photoshop_merge_visible_layers
description: Merge all visible layers into one

name: photoshop_flatten_image
description: Flatten all layers into a single background layer

name: photoshop_create_layer
description: Create a new empty layer above the active layer.\n\n

name: photoshop_delete_layer
description: Delete the active layer in the open Photoshop document

name: photoshop_create_text_layer
description: Create a text layer with content, position, font size, and optional font.\n\n

name: photoshop_fill_layer
description: Fill the active layer with a color

name: photoshop_get_layers
description: List all layers in the active document with kind, visibility, and opacity.\n\n

name: photoshop_select_layer_by_name
description: Select the active layer by exact name, including layers inside groups.\n\n

name: photoshop_fit_layer_to_document
description: Scale the active layer to fit the document canvas while maintaining aspect ratio

name: photoshop_scale_layer
description: Scale the active layer by a percentage

name: photoshop_move_layer
description: Move the active layer by specified offset

name: photoshop_rotate_layer
description: Rotate the active Photoshop layer by an angle in degrees

name: photoshop_apply_gradient_mask
description: Apply a linear black-to-white gradient on the active layer mask channel (fade/blend).\n\n

name: photoshop_create_clipping_mask
description: Create a clipping mask on the active layer (or a named layer).\n\n

name: photoshop_release_clipping_mask
description: Release (remove) the clipping mask from the active layer (or a named layer).\n\n

name: photoshop_get_selection_bounds
description: Read the active pixel selection bounds in document pixels (read-only).\n\n

name: photoshop_select_ellipse
description: Create an elliptical pixel selection from a bounding box (anti-aliased).\n\n

name: photoshop_expand_selection
description: Expand the active pixel selection outward by a pixel amount.\n\n

name: photoshop_contract_selection
description: Contract (shrink) the active pixel selection inward by a pixel amount.\n\n

name: photoshop_feather_selection
description: Feather (soften) the edges of the active pixel selection.\n\n

name: photoshop_save_selection
description: Save the active pixel selection to a new alpha channel.\n\n

name: photoshop_select_rectangle
description: Create a rectangular pixel selection from corner coordinates.\n\n

name: photoshop_select_all
description: Select the whole Photoshop canvas on the active layer

name: photoshop_deselect
description: Clear the current selection in Photoshop so the whole layer is affected

name: photoshop_invert_selection
description: Invert the current Photoshop selection to select everything else

name: photoshop_create_layer_mask
description: Create a layer mask on the active layer from the current selection (reveal selection).\n\n

name: photoshop_delete_layer_mask
description: Delete the layer mask from active layer

name: photoshop_apply_layer_mask
description: Apply (merge) the layer mask to the layer

name: photoshop_select_subject
description: Run Select Subject on the active layer (creates a pixel selection only, no mask).\n\n

name: photoshop_content_aware_fill
description: Fill the current pixel selection using Content-Aware Fill.\n\n

name: photoshop_convert_to_smart_object
description: Convert the active layer (or a named layer) to an embedded Smart Object.\n\n

name: photoshop_replace_smart_object_contents
description: Replace the embedded contents of a Smart Object layer from an image file. Preserves transforms, warps, and Smart Filters on the layer.\n\n

name: photoshop_edit_smart_object_contents
description: Open a Smart Object for editing (double-click / Edit Contents). The embedded .psb becomes the active document until you save and close it.\n\n

name: photoshop_create_smart_object_via_copy
description: Create an independent Smart Object via Copy — unlinked duplicate with its own embedded contents.\n\n

name: photoshop_image_stack
description: Load 2+ image files into one document, convert to a smart object and apply a stack mode (mean/median/max/min/...). Classic "remove tourists from N shots" or noise reduction — no generative AI involved.\n\n

name: photoshop_get_state
description: Return a cheap read-only snapshot of Photoshop session state (active document, layer, selection).\n\n

name: photoshop_get_preview
description: Export the active document as a base64 JPEG preview for visual verification.\n\n

name: photoshop_get_capabilities
description: Return version-aware feature flags for the installed Photoshop (Select Subject v2, Generative Fill, etc.).\n\n

name: photoshop_apply_layer_style
description: Apply a layer style (drop shadow, outer glow, stroke, bevel & emboss) to the active layer via Action Manager layer effects.\n\n

name: photoshop_list_fonts
description: List installed fonts available to Photoshop.\n\n

name: photoshop_set_text_font
description: Set font family and size for active text layer.\n\n

name: photoshop_set_text_color
description: Set color for active text layer

name: photoshop_set_text_alignment
description: Set text alignment for active text layer

name: photoshop_update_text_content
description: Update the text content of active text layer

name: photoshop_recipe_remove_background
description: Recipe: remove the background from a photo with a subject mask

name: photoshop_recipe_enhance_portrait
description: Recipe: enhance a portrait photo: skin, eyes, contrast and color

name: photoshop_recipe_prepare_for_web
description: Recipe: resize, sharpen and export an image for the web

name: photoshop_recipe_export_social_variants
description: Recipe: export an image as social media sizes and crops in one pass

name: photoshop_recipe_apply_color_grade
description: Recipe: apply a color grade to a photo with curves and a color balance look

name: photoshop_recipe_frequency_separation
description: Recipe: frequency separation layers to retouch skin texture and tone apart

name: photoshop_recipe_batch_mockup_replace
description: Recipe: put one design into many mockup files by replacing their smart objects

name: photoshop_recipe_organize_layers
description: Recipe: tidy a Photoshop document by naming, grouping and ordering its layers

name: photoshop_recipe_gradient_fade
description: Recipe: fade an image out with a gradient layer mask

name: photoshop_recipe_sky_blend
description: Recipe: replace or blend the sky in a landscape photo

name: photoshop_recipe_dodge_burn
description: Recipe: dodge and burn layers to lighten and darken parts of a photo

name: photoshop_recipe_remove_distraction
description: Recipe: remove a distracting object from a photo with content-aware fill

name: photoshop_recipe_split_carousel
description: Recipe: split a wide image into equal slides for a swipe carousel post

name: photoshop_recipe_batch_watermark
description: Recipe: add a watermark to a batch of images and save them

name: photoshop_recipe_passport_photo
description: Recipe: crop and size a passport photo with a plain background

name: photoshop_recipe_csv_to_cards
description: Recipe: build cards from a CSV file, one image per row with its text and pictures
